title: Trust Across Borders
text:
Trust between nations is rarely built through a single dramatic gesture. More often it grows slowly, through repeated exchanges of information, small favours and consistent behaviour over many years. When a government keeps its promises even when they are costly, neighbours begin to treat its statements as reliable. Such credibility is fragile, however, and a single broken commitment can undo decades of patient work.

This is why diplomats often prefer modest, verifiable steps to sweeping declarations. A joint inspection, an agreed hotline, or a shared scientific project may seem unimpressive, yet each one creates a record of cooperation that others can check. Critics sometimes dismiss these measures as timid. Experienced negotiators, however, know that confidence is built on evidence rather than on promises alone.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, how does trust between nations usually grow?
options: Slowly, through repeated exchanges and consistent behaviour

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what kind of steps do diplomats often prefer?
What can be inferred about a government that breaks one commitment?
options: Its credibility may be seriously damaged
It will always be trusted again immediately
It has no influence on its neighbours
It has been praised by critics

questions.text: What does the writer suggest about critics of modest measures?
options: They fully understand how confidence is built
They may underestimate how trust is built through evidence

vocabulary.definition: the quality of being believed and trusted
able to be checked and confirmed
people who discuss terms in order to reach an agreement

paragraph_translations: በሀገራት መካከል ያለ መተማመን አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በአንድ አስደናቂ ምልክት አይገነባም። ብዙ ጊዜ ቀስ በቀስ፣ በመረጃ ልውውጥ፣ በትናንሽ ውለታዎችና ለዓመታት በተከታታይ በሚታይ ባህሪ ያድጋል። አንድ መንግሥት ዋጋ ቢያስከፍለውም ቃሉን ሲጠብቅ፣ ጎረቤቶቹ መግለጫዎቹን አስተማማኝ አድርገው መቁጠር ይጀምራሉ። ሆኖም እንዲህ ያለው ተአማኒነት ደካማ ነው፤ አንድ የተበላሸ ቃል ለአሥርተ ዓመታት የቆየ ትዕግሥተኛ ሥራን ሊያፈርስ ይችላል።

ዲፕሎማቶች ብዙ ጊዜ ከታላላቅ መግለጫዎች ይልቅ ልከኛ፣ ሊረጋገጡ የሚችሉ እርምጃዎችን የሚመርጡት ለዚህ ነው። የጋራ ምርመራ፣ የተስማሙበት ቀጥተኛ የስልክ መስመር ወይም የጋራ ሳይንሳዊ ፕሮጀክት ትንሽ ቢመስልም፣ እያንዳንዱ ሌሎች ሊፈትሹት የሚችል የትብብር መዝገብ ይፈጥራል። ተቺዎች አንዳንድ ጊዜ እነዚህን እርምጃዎች እንደ ፈሪነት ያጣጥላሉ። ልምድ ያላቸው ተደራዳሪዎች ግን መተማመን የሚገነባው በተስፋ ብቻ ሳይሆን በማስረጃ ላይ መሆኑን ያውቃሉ።
